qcDashboard.title: Exploration Dashboard
qcDashboard.intro: Control charts of the OREAS standards in the data source, against their certified values in the CRM List.

steps.1: Pick a standard under Oreas Criteria. Each point is one assay of that standard, at its row in the Data Source.
steps.2: The green, yellow and red lines are ±1σ, ±2σ and ±3σ of the certified value (Fusion XRF) in the CRM List. Points outside ±3σ are drawn red and counted under the chart.
steps.3: The Elements button chooses which elements' charts show (Ni, Co, Fe2O3, Al2O3, Cr2O3, MgO, SiO2). The choice is kept in this browser.
steps.4: Values that are not numbers (such as <0.01) are not drawn; how many is said under the chart.

qcDashboard.tip: Fill the Control column of a STANDARD row with its OREAS name (e.g. OREAS-184) so its assays reach the charts.

dataSource.title: Data Source
dataSource.intro: Every assayed sample and its QC samples. The Standard, Blank and Duplicate menus show one type each.

steps.1: Add opens an Excel-like sheet page: type or paste a block from Excel into the empty rows. The latest 50 rows sit locked above; click the padlock to change one in place, then Save them all at once.
steps.2: Search by Sample ID, Hole ID, Control or Campaign, and filter by campaign (and by sample type on the Data Source).
steps.3: Click a row to open its details in a panel on the right: the sample's identity, all sixteen assay results and its history, with Edit and Delete buttons. The pencil and bin icons in the row do the same directly.
steps.4: Import uploads thousands of rows at once from Excel/CSV (preview first, failed rows can be downloaded); Export downloads the list on screen with that menu's columns, ready to import back.
steps.5: Drag a column heading left or right to reorder it (or Alt+←/→), and choose the columns shown with the Columns button. The assay results (Ni to MC) are hidden by default; tick them under Columns to see them in the table. The arrangement is kept per menu in this browser; Export still has all of the menu's columns.

dataSource.tip: Sample IDs must be unique. On the Standard, Blank and Duplicate menus the sample type is filled in from the menu.

1.title: You run the Eksplorasi module
1.body: The Data Source holds every sample; Standard, Blank and Duplicate keep the QC samples apart; the Dashboard charts them.

2.title: Help is always there
2.body: Press ? at the top of any page for that page's guide.
